correctness.rationale: For a fixed local ancestral path, strictly decreasing i.i.d. arrival marks and independent binomial tie-count kernels give the exact integral (1). The positive Lipschitz change-of-variable weights around the unique endpoint of the normalized triangle kernel yield the sharp harmonic-number factorial prefactor with relative O_d(1/k) error. A union bound and independent packed radius-k balls give summable upper and lower tail probabilities for the maximal local run, proving the almost-sure scale. The exact small-parameter verification was replayed using the bundled checker; it is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first transition from genuinely local to nonlocal ancestry is an intrinsic geometric statistic of the newly studied seedless infinite-tree genealogy. A full exact distribution and sharp degree-dependent harmonic factorial constant quantify the rarity of sustained nearest-neighbor inheritance, and an almost-sure extreme law describes the longest local stretch visible in an expanding region. This is more structural than a routine one-step probability and does not follow from a mere name change or a known table.
